name: Ricotta & Spinach Pasta with Toasted Pine Nuts

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into 6-mm pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Finely grate 1 ½ cup of Parmesan. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Once cooked, drain the pasta in a colander, reserving 1 ½ cup of the cooking water.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp salt
426 g (about 4 ½ cups) penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Add the pine nuts to the pan; cook, stirring constantly, until they are golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl.
Once the pine nuts have been transferred, add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the spinach to the pan and season the mixture with salt and pepper; cook, tossing frequently, until the spinach is wilted, 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the ricotta to the pan and stir until it is thoroughly mixed with the spinach.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (425 g) pkg (1 cup) ricotta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add the pasta, about ½ of the Parmesan, and reserved cooking water to the pan; cook, stirring constantly, until the pasta is well combined, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the pasta between bowls, garnish with the remaining Parmesan, and sprinkle with the toasted pine nuts. Enjoy!
